description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.3.3 of the OrangeHRM system, handling schema changes such as altering columns and managing foreign key constraints.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration to perform database schema updates for OrangeHRM version 4.3.3.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration: removes conflicting foreign keys, alters column types and properties, then restores foreign keys.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.3.3' for this migration.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign keys in specific tables that conflict with the migration, returning them for removal and re-adding.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign keys identified as conflicting before schema changes.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Re-adds previously removed foreign keys after schema modifications.
